description: GUI default (Phase 128, 2026-11-04): the generic twin turboprop of Cabin_Noise's default project (cabin_noise/data/default_project.json), its values copied by hand; the two programs share no code or file. Cruise, 7620 m ISA, Mach 0.4818, 6 blades, 1181 rpm, tip radius 1.7526 m, tip-to-fuselage clearance 1.1 m, cabin 22.7 m long and 2.64 m wide, skin 1.6 mm of density 2780, double wall: 0.09 m blanket cavity behind a 2.7 kg/m2 trim panel. Inputs Cabin_Noise does not have are stated in 'assumptions'. Not a validation case: no comparison with data.
assumptions: Radius a = cabin width / 2 = 1.32 m (Cabin_Noise models a box, PAIN a cylinder).
Hub distance r_p = a + tip radius + clearance = 4.1726 m; propeller plane at mid-cabin, z_p = L/2 = 11.35 m (Cabin_Noise has no station relative to the cabin).
Blade stations, chords and hub radius: the shape of examples/aircraft_scale_hartzell.json scaled by 1.7526/0.381 (Cabin_Noise uses a Gutin source with no blade geometry).

Twist: the geometric advance angle atan(V/(Omega r)) plus 3 deg at each station, from the cruise speed and rpm above; no value is fitted to a result. Shaft power (1.64 MW in Cabin_Noise) is not a PAIN input.
Outside air: ISA at 7620 m (T 238.62 K). Cabin air: the pressure of ISA 2438.4 m at 293.15 K, the formulas of Cabin_Noise's atmosphere.py.
ANOPP Table 8 scaling off: Table 8 is the 0.762 m Hartzell test, not this propeller.
Insulation table extrapolated (X-EXTRAP): the 22.7 m cabin has structural modes from about 13 Hz, below the 100 Hz start of the PF-105 table.
Harmonics: 5 (Cabin_Noise's auto takes every harmonic below 5 kHz).
